prompt: Inside a high-tech greenhouse within a Mars colony, enclosed by a large glass dome. Rows of hydroponic trays are filled with various glowing plants, a result of genetic modification. A sleek robotic arm is tending to one of the trays, connected to a network of nutrient tubes. A large solar panel is visible through the dome, powering the facility. A control panel with a glowing data screen displays vital statistics. Specialized LED lamps hang from the ceiling, providing optimized light. A metal walkway runs between the trays. On a workbench, a Martian soil sample sits next to an astronaut helmet and a small oxygen tank. An open tool kit lies beside a beaker and a specimen jar containing a strange root. A digital temperature gauge is mounted on the wall near a ventilation fan. A folded space suit is on a rack. A single packet of seeds for 'Earth Kale' is on the bench. This is an entirely artificial environment; there are no naturally growing trees, and the sealed dome means there are no birds or insects. Looking up through the dome, the sky is clear, without a single cloud or any sign of rain, and all watering is automated, so a simple watering can would be useless here.
